summary:
# 今日社区动态（deepseek-flash | 2026-11-23 ~ 2026-11-24）

- ⚡ x86/kstack_erase 加速栈毒化过程，同时修复 startup 阶段构建问题（[Architecture](#subsystem-Architecture)）
- ✨ KVM x86 引入 guest APX 支持，扩展 CPUID、指令模拟与 VMX/SVM 寄存器处理（[Virtualization](#subsystem-Virtualization)）
- 🔥 将 AT_VECTOR_SIZE_ARCH 移出 UAPI，统一各架构 auxvec 头文件定义（[Architecture](#subsystem-Architecture)）
- ⚡ swap 设备分配引入优先级队列，按设备优先级与负载选择 swap 设备提升吞吐（[Memory](#subsystem-Memory)）
- 🔧 platform bus 与 PM domain 增加 probe 阶段跳过上电的选项，由驱动决定上电时机（[Drivers](#subsystem-Drivers)）
- ⚡ cgroup/cpuset v2 掩码更新与域重建加速，提升 cpuset 分区变更效率（[Core Kernel](#subsystem-Core%20Kernel)）

## Filesystem & Storage
- arm64 Rockchip RK3576 通过 OTP CPU ID 派生 MAC 地址，新增 nvmem fixed-cell 布局与 rockchip-otp 支持，免去逐板烧录 MAC。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-rk3576-otp-cpuid-mac-v3-0-40c756dcf36f@flipper.net/)
- exfat 新增 EXFAT_IOC_COMBINE ioctl，可把一个文件的簇区间追加到另一个文件，供用户态做快速合并与去重。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123132742.743416-1-shaopei_1012@163.com/)
- block 引入块设备作为 NVMEM provider 的框架，含 genhd 集成与分区 OF 解析，使存储设备可承载配置数据。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-block-as-nvmem-v13-0-96ffe1f59332@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- `other` nvme-auth v6 改用内核 keyring 管理 DH-CHAP 密钥，统一 host/target 认证路径，去掉自带密钥存储。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-dhchap-keyring-v4-v6-0-5082a49715ab@kernel.org/)
- `other` nvme-auth v5 将 NVMe 认证密钥迁移到内核 keyring，简化原有密钥管理实现，已被 v6 修订取代。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-dhchap-keyring-v4-v5-0-81eefb4c0724@kernel.org/)
- `bugfix` nfsd 修复委托时间戳相关的多处不一致，覆盖回调、状态与 vfs 路径，避免委托期间时间戳错乱。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-delegts-fixes-v2-0-960ce0fb2fed@kernel.org/)
- `bugfix` fuse 修复 fuse_set_nowrite 与并行 direct write 的竞态，避免 6.12 稳定版中出现写数据与缓存状态不一致。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123141235.2477526-1-graypanda.inzag@gmail.com/)
- `other` block/dm 在底层 max_discard_sectors 之上叠加 max_hw_discard_sectors，修正 DM 设备丢弃能力向底层传递的方式。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123193000.3419445-1-bmarzins@redhat.com/)
- `other` NFS 在持有写委托时 close 不再等待回写完成，降低关闭延迟，改善写委托场景的吞吐表现。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-nfs-space-limit-v3-1-993945e1a526@kernel.org/)
- `bugfix` btrfs 修复 raid stripe tree 提交根搜索中的 use-after-free，防止树查找期间访问已释放节点。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123182354.2091665-1-mc@raidlab.org/)
- 另有 9 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123181408.62972-1-laveeshb@laveeshbansal.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123111452.237422-1-ngocthang2710.1999@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123091933.42057-1-ngocthang2710.1999@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123175633.2058431-1-mc@raidlab.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123172856.100887-2-arbabhaider649@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123102320.8590-1-zihengw03@163.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123164021.463361-1-thiery.louis@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123084701.2616027-1-pulpannie@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123124213.1102958-1-zhanggenjian@126.com/)

## Architecture
- `perf` `bugfix` [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123174703.133167-1-usama.arif@linux.dev/) x86/kstack_erase 加速栈毒化过程，同时修复 startup 阶段构建问题
- `perf` [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121-a733-cubie-a7s-dt-v5-0@gmail.com/) arm64 dts 新增 Allwinner A733 SoC 与 Cubie A7S 板级支持
- `perf` `bugfix` [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123162315.1142701-1-usama.arif@linux.dev/) perf/x86/amd/ibs 修复 PERF_SAMPLE_WEIGHT_STRUCT 泄漏栈内容，堵住信息泄露
- [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-at-vector-size-arch-v3-0-d342dae9e843@linutronix.de/) 将 AT_VECTOR_SIZE_ARCH 移出 UAPI，统一各架构 auxvec 头文件定义
- [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123104233.95710-1-steven.price@arm.com/) KVM/arm64 引入 CCA Realm 内存管理基础设施，为机密计算虚拟机铺路
- [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123092244.1792040-1-virag.david003@gmail.com/) 为 Exynos7885 增加 USB 支持，含 PHY 与 DWC3 绑定及 DT
- [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-vdso-absolute-reloc-v6-0-161e218dd217@linutronix.de/) vdso 构建阶段拒绝绝对重定位，覆盖 arm64/x86 等多架构 vdso Makefile
- [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-b4-pdm_clk_gp_mnd_v2-v3-0-98db26a87500@oss.qualcomm.com/) 新增 Qualcomm PDM GP_MN 分数分频时钟驱动及多平台 DT 节点
- `bugfix` [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123103106.953938-1-pbonzini@redhat.com/) KVM arm64 修复集：涉及 cpufeature、pKVM 页表与 nested 等多处修正
- [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-initial-mt6895-v3-0-95c46597e63d@gmail.com/) arm64 dts 新增 MediaTek MT6895 及小米 Poco X4 GT 初始支持
- 另有 42 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-rockchip-jpegdec-v8-0-3316cd31b043@pengutronix.de/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-meson-drm-create-hdmitx-phy-v4-0-3fb94f5534ca@aliel.fr/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123124946.13887-1-stefano.r@variscite.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-qcm2290-eud-v2-0-9bfc432dee07@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-stmfts5-v9-1-3ab247cd32c0@ixit.cz/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123122857.2424213-1-akash.kumar@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-lemans-draco-final-changes-bringup-v4-0-dbfc15cd0883@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-monaco-draco-v2-0-3ee3b2375f16@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-rk3588-mekotronics-r58x-pro-v2-0-2a3430cf5f88@pardini.net/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-upstream-s7-clk-dt-v1-0-95f46d67d8b4@baylibre.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123085840.8687-1-l.scorcia@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-sdhi_rzg3l-v2-0-bad3a6358849@bp.renesas.com/) 等 41 项

## Drivers
- BCM2835 DMA 增加 BCM2711/2712 40 位寻址，配套更新 DT 与 HDMI/MMC/SPI 消费端，RPi5 外设可访问高地址。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123145728.29082-1-andrea.porta@suse.com/)
- platform bus 与 PM domain 增加 probe 阶段跳过上电的选项，驱动可自行决定何时启用电源域。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123084218.673382-1-b-padhi@ti.com/)
- 新增 MAX34417 四通道高动态范围功率累加器 ADC 驱动及 binding。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-topic-sm8x50-iio-max34417-adc-v7-0-d8f87edc5086@linaro.org/)
- `bugfix` ：HID 核心与多个驱动修复空指针、锁与引用计数问题，覆盖 logitech/playstation/wacom 等。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123155138.2907049-1-lee@kernel.org/)
- drm_pagemap_util 删除不存在的成员 kernel-doc，修正文档与结构体不一致。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123125127.4114196-1-takano32@gmail.com/)
- `perf` `other` ：vkms 预计算 gamma LUT，合成时直接查表，降低每帧 LUT 计算开销。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-lut-v1-0-5556c89a2ebd@gmail.com/)
- `bugfix` ：MMC 多个 host 驱动修复错误处理与状态检查，涉及 dw_mmc、sdhci-msm、renesas_sdhi 等。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123191703.179283-1-lee@kernel.org/)
- 另有 41 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-audigy-fx-pro-quirk-v1-1-5fbc574e25d3@proton.me/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123150725.212836-1-clamor95@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123102740.1389-1-atharvatiwarilinuxdev@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-b4-rdmctmzt-v3-1-5ce2359df0aa@pm.me/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-b4-rdmctmzt-v2-1-8c18d7dac4bc@pm.me/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20260728-tyr-irq-v2-v7-0-4e172e58e28c@collabora.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123194943.57601-1-gerard@teslabs.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-b4-cs7542-nand-v1-0-7ce179c011e2@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-b4-cs7542-trng-v1-0-92d9ffcee531@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-b4-cs7542-rtc-v1-0-6c53761ffa03@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123100228.77797-1-clamor95@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123100535.3025-1-sreekuttan2156239@gmail.com/) 等 41 项

## Networking
- arm64 qcom monaco-arduino-monza 增加 LGA WiFi/BT 模块支持，新增 M.2 E-key 连接器绑定并适配 hci_qca [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-monza-wireless-v9-0-450d7d764aea@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- `other` 完成 gpiolib legacy 清理，mm81x 无线驱动随之迁移到新接口 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123085723.156933-1-arnd@kernel.org/)
- genetlink 拒绝加入无任何 family 所有的多播组，避免无效组播订阅 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123155503.2497063-1-anilkaushikwireless@gmail.com/)
- adin1110 增加 OPEN Alliance TC6 支持，oa_tc6 与 phy 驱动同步扩展 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123115743.29523-1-iustin.stolniceanu@analog.com/)
- 隧道核心及 GRE/IPIP/SIT 新增 drop reason，丢包可归因到具体隧道路径 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123104210.199916-1-littlesmilingcloud@gmail.com/)
- 新增 TCP/MPTCP 黑洞超时 sysctl，避免超时算术回绕 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795424546.git.x-professor@outlook.com/)
- ath11k 在 REO reap 中合并同一 station 的 TCP 段，减少上行包量 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123135010.721107-1-julius@bairaktaris.de/)
- cfg80211 加入的 IBSS 尚无 BSS 表项时不再告警 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-wifi-ibss-joined-lookup-v1-1-0d84745eac94@aclaesson.com/)
- `other` ARP 不再从 L2 组播/广播帧更新邻居表，防止伪造邻居条目 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123144535.155300-1-starchang@google.com/)
- `other` smc 将 failover 游标追赶限制在实际未完成量内 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123135327.3953509-1-piyus@iiitd.ac.in/)
- 另有 26 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-b4-02-act-ife-rtnl-uaf-v3-3e43796c4fc1-v3-1-93fa0f782cf4@pm.me/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123122732.2971-1-me@7xz.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123104236.4179425-1-rmustafin@cloudlinux.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123122432.297135-1-jiayuan.chen@linux.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123134137.718575-1-julius@bairaktaris.de/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-b4-cs7542-ethernet-v1-0-fdb5e8c2d508@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123090200.1284018-1-xuanqiang.luo@linux.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123100746.1975030-1-vikas.gupta@broadcom.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123164835.1733304-1-florian.fainelli@broadcom.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-b4-cs7542-mdio-v1-0-626d0a0e3b4d@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-nb-genet-mtu-nn-v2-v9-0-4f93ded19bbb@tipi-net.de/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/179543215348.11880.18316180385674365789@mail.zgclab.edu.cn/) 等 26 项

## Virtualization
- 为 KVM x86 引入 guest APX 支持，扩展 CPUID、指令模拟及 VMX/SVM 寄存器处理，使 guest 可用新一代通用寄存器。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123173732.1072124-1-chang.seok.bae@intel.com/)
- `bugfix` 修复 Windows guest 下嵌套 VMX 的 APICv 模拟，调整 VMCS 与 SMM 寄存器保存恢复路径。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123175512.80438-1-mlevitsk@redhat.com/)
- 以 vCPU 的 dirty ring 为 KVM_PRE_FAULT_MEMORY 设定上限，约束可预映射范围，避免无界预取。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123113435.1170711-1-fuad.tabba@linux.dev/)
- `other` vhost-vdpa 地址映射时跳过未映射空洞，避免区间缺口导致映射失败或重复遍历。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123143318.73514-1-fangxy@xiaopeng.com/)

## Clocks & Timers
- Cortina CS7542 新增全局时钟控制器与引脚复用驱动，含 DT 绑定，使新 SoC 可初始化时钟树 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-cs7542-syscon-v1-0-49858e631449@gmail.com/)
- `bugfix` 批量修正 clk core 与多平台驱动的杂项缺陷，含 divider、composite、GPIO 门控错误处理 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123164834.3330320-1-lee@kernel.org/)
- 为 msm8953 平台 GCC 补充摄像头相关时钟，使 Xiaomi Tissot 前后摄可正常取时钟 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123110805.119610-1-hikmahgumelar@gmail.com/)
- `perf` Rockchip 新增 RK3572 时钟/复位驱动及 fractional divider v2，提升新 SoC 高频时钟精度与支持度 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-add-board-ok3572-c-clk-v7-0-16f6860191a9@qq.com/)
- 另有 2 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-exynos5-subcmu-defer-v1-0-43aef47d4f2b@docomonet.jp/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123112053.20400-1-changhuang.liang@starfivetech.com/)

## Power Management
- PM runtime 新增运行时统计与汇总指标，帮助定位设备运行时电源管理的延迟热点。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-pm-runtime-summary-v3-0-81a966953a81@kernel.org/)
- max8907 增加 DT schema 与平台数据支持，并补齐 poweroff 能力，使该 MFD/regulator 驱动可完整由设备树描述。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123150224.199601-1-clamor95@gmail.com/)

## Memory
- `perf` 为 swap 设备分配引入优先级队列（plist），按设备优先级与负载选择 swap 设备，提升多设备 swapping 吞吐 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795439990.git.lianux.mm@gmail.com/)
- `perf` `other` MGLRU 用 rculist_nulls 与 mmzone 结构调整降低 memcg 轮转开销，减少回收路径锁竞争 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123135200.4086519-1-max.kellermann@ionos.com/)
- `perf` `other` memfd_luo 不再调用 memfd_pin_folios，改用自有页处理路径，减少长期 pin 带来的迁移限制 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123130115.4021199-1-pratyush@kernel.org/)
- `perf` MGLRU 引入以访问频率为导向的晋升策略（MGLRU-FG），并清理相关标志；多个负载测试显示回收与晋升效率提升 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-mglru-fg-v6-8ffea39934a6@tencent.com/)
- 在 nokmem 场景下恢复 NONSLAB shrinker 的 per-memcg 回收，涉及 memcontrol、list_lru、zswap 与 THP [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123105334.2524066-1-qinyuntan@linux.alibaba.com/)
- memfd_luo 让 memfd 在完成前保持冻结状态，避免 liveupdate 交接期间被写入 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123130509.4032642-1-pratyush@kernel.org/)
- `other` 清理 get_page_from_freelist 相关代码，拆分 page_alloc 辅助函数以简化分配热路径逻辑 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123181829.4065581-1-joshua.hahnjy@gmail.com/)
- `bugfix` 修复 THP 迁移、swap-in 与 device-private smaps 统计的多处问题，涉及 memory.c、migrate_device.c 与 task_mmu.c [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123163301.1568240-1-usama.arif@linux.dev/)
- `other` page_vma_mkclean_one 改为每次映射只 flush 一次 TLB，减少批量 mkclean 时的 TLB 开销 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-feat-mm-mkclean-batch-flush-v1-1-7e998ad13251@linux.dev/)
- `other` shmem 在 init_on_alloc=1 时避免对新 folio 重复清零，省去一次无谓的内存写 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-samridh-shmem-send-v3-1-afc6a40bc187@modal.com/)
- 另有 2 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-shmem-swap-write-failed-v1-41a0115dfbf1@columbia.edu/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/6fcc15c466667f6943c34e130212b891b7471c83.1795436423.git.baolin.wang@linux.alibaba.com/)

## Scheduling
- 引入 Kernel Assurance Plane 安全框架，新增 securityfs 接口及 fork/nsproxy 挂钩，为内核完整性提供保障机制（RFC） [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123114308.8103-1-harisudhan@armoriq.io/)
- `perf` 恢复 rt 调度器在 next_task 禁止迁移时的 PUSH_IPI 回退路径，避免任务滞留在运行队列，改善实时负载均衡 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-migrate-on-ipi-v1-0-eacfe7e4b808@outlook.com/)
- sched_ext 禁止在 ops.dump 与 init_cids 中调用 unlocked kfunc，防止在受限上下文执行内核操作，并补齐自测覆盖 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123135343.4131146-1-jpiecuch@google.com/)
- `bugfix` 修正 SCX_ENQ_CPU_SELECTED 在排队唤醒路径的处理，确保调度器选定的 CPU 被正确采用 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123171637.3859594-1-jpiecuch@google.com/)
- `bugfix` 修复 sched_ext dispatch 中 ops_state 与 ops.dequeue 的加锁不一致，避免并发下状态错乱 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123170846.3165648-1-jpiecuch@google.com/)
- `bugfix` 收紧 kfunc 内的 RCU 保护范围，修正未持锁访问并补足临界区，消除潜在释放后使用 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123145927.577162-1-jpiecuch@google.com/)

## Security
- AppArmor 将异步文件信号纳入 LSM 中介，扩展 fcntl 路径访问控制，补上信号传递的审计盲区 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/ACA178EA434CEC59+cover.1795434950.git.shilc2025@mail.sustech.edu.cn/)
- SELinux 在 __ad_net_init 中初始化 sport/dport，避免网络地址比较使用未初始化端口字段 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123113724.35381-1-e.orehov@ideco.ru/)
- `other` crypto xcbc 改用 init_tfm/exit_tfm 替代旧 cra_init/cra_exit 接口，跟进加密 API 迁移 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123104030.5378-1-raizudeen.kerneldev@gmail.com/)

## Core Kernel
- `perf` `other` cgroup/cpuset v2 掩码更新与域重建加速，提升 cpuset 分区变更效率 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795436486.git.zhouchuyi@bytedance.com/)
- kobject uevent 预留 envp 终止槽位，避免环境变量拼接越界 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795426787.git.caoruide123@gmail.com/)
- sched/deadline 与 RT 限流清理，移除冗余代码并补充文档 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-sched_dl-v4-0-d523e4d960d3@linutronix.de/)
- `bugfix` kobject 修复 tagged uevent 广播中的释放后使用问题，消除内存安全风险 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123160615.1074229-1-omermetekaya0@gmail.com/)
- `other` softirq 将 BH 计数告警限定于使用 RT BH 锁的代码，减少误报 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/4103eb7e6caea1afad16e5523ded3f2a30c40ee8.1795455101.git.cyyzero16@gmail.com/)
- `bugfix` signal 在 sys_signal 中初始化 k_sigaction，避免未初始化字段泄漏 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123091329.3658965-1-bsdhenrymartin@gmail.com/)
- `bugfix` kcsan 扩展检测覆盖到跨 CPU 的 {READ,WRITE}_ONCE_THIS_CPU 竞争 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123135148.1146372-1-elver@google.com/)
- `bugfix` lib/buildid 调整 ELF note 大小对齐方式，防止整数溢出 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123142510.51241-2-blum@kernel.org/)

## Observability
- `perf` `bugfix` 构建仅在 Clang 23 及以上启用 context analysis，避免旧编译器解析选项失败 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-james-perf-late-parse-attr-v1-1-cfebcd81a962@linaro.org/)
- `perf` `bugfix` 修复 Event re-armed with PERF_EVENT_IOC_REFRESH 测试中的竞态，减少自测偶发失败 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-james-perf-event_refresh-v1-1-571efa5395ab@linaro.org/)
- bpf 为 tracing link_create 增加日志支持，覆盖 verifier、cgroup、trampoline 与 libbpf，便于定位挂载失败原因 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123152743.19629-1-leon.hwang@linux.dev/)
- pidfd_poll_test 声明 TAP 计划，使 selftest 输出被解析器正确统计 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123150127.635412-1-georgeezra017@gmail.com/)
- `perf` 新增 MIPS CM3 性能计数器 PMU 驱动，配套文档与 defconfig，使 MIPS 平台可做硬件性能采样 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-i6500-cm3-pmu-v4-0-5a9f5351688f@mobileye.com/)
- `other` LoongArch KVM PMU selftest 补 MAINTAINERS 覆盖并修复 VM 泄漏 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123100701.1679376-1-gokul02k@gmail.com/)
- `bugfix` vCPU 被抢占时 dirty ring 条目丢失，修改 virt/kvm/dirty_ring.c 并新增 x86 自测覆盖 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123153238.1036972-1-smish149@asu.edu/)
- `bugfix` 修正 rv.h 中的 BTF 混淆，同步调整 rv 监控与 kunit 代码，避免监控器元数据解析错乱 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123083709.62502-1-gmonaco@redhat.com/)
